message.content: Good morning, Assistant. I need to send a quick email to the heritage society. I’ve changed the venue for our next gathering.

content.text: Good morning, Krzysztof. I can help with that. You mentioned changing the venue. Where are you moving the meeting to?

message.content: To Community Centre Room B. I made that decision on Saturday 21 March, so I want the members to know it’s final.

content.text: Understood. Shall I draft a message saying: 'Dear Members, please note that our upcoming heritage society meeting will now be held in Community Centre Room B. This change was decided on Saturday 21 March. See you there.' Does that sound right?

message.content: Yes, that is perfect. Please send it. Also, while you are at it, I have been thinking about my newspaper. I am only thinking about changing the weekly newspaper delivery to Gazeta Krakowska; nothing decided.

content.text: Noted. I will keep that in mind for your preferences, but I won't make any changes until you confirm. Is there anything else regarding the heritage society or your daily plans?

message.content: No, that’s all for now. I need to go check the tomatoes in the allotment garden before the rain comes.

content.text: Good idea. The forecast does suggest showers later. Have a good day, Krzysztof.
